technique_name: Explain the difference between HTML and CSS.
description: HTML (HyperText Markup Language) is a markup language used to create the structure of a webpage. CSS (Cascading Style Sheets) is the language used for styling and laying out a webpage. HTML is a markup language that provides the structure for a web page and consists of HTML elements and attributes. These elements and attributes define the content and any visual element that appear on a page. CSS is used to modify and enhance the visual appearance of the page.
